Statement: The offered price is at most the committed cost plus the policy maximum markup: offered_price * 10000 <= total_cost * (10000 + max_markup_bps).

max_markup_bps.description: Markup cap in basis points. The verifier refuses a proof whose cap is looser than the registry policy.

offered_price.description: The offered price, in the smallest unit of the frame unit.

context.description: Non-zero reference to the offer, for example a hash of the quote id. The verifier compares it when the caller names the offer.

total_cost.description: The provider total cost, in the same unit as offered_price.

salt.description: Random blinding value for the cost commitment.

cost_commitment.description: Poseidon2(DOMAIN, total_cost, salt). Binds the prover to one cost it can open to an auditor.

Limits: Proves the price is consistent with a committed cost. It does not prove the cost is true: an auditor checks that by asking the provider to open the commitment.
